test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a class, 25 students like maths and history, 25 students like only Hindi, 30 students like only English, 20 students like English and Hindi both, 15 students like only history and 15 students like only maths. 15 students like all 4 subjects. How many total students are there in the class?
solution:
Given:

Students like Maths and History = 25

Students like only Hindi = 25

Students like only English = 30

Students like English and Hindi both = 20

Students like only History = 15

Students like only Maths = 15

Students like all 4 subjects = 15

Concept Used:

Total = (Maths + History) + (Hindi) + (English) - (English and Hindi) + (History) + (Maths) - (All 4)

Calculation:

According to the concept,

Total = (25 + 15) + 25 + 30 - 20 + 15 + 15 - 15

⇒ 40 + 25 + 30 + 15 + 15 + 15 - 15

⇒ 145

**∴ There are 145 students in the class.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3925d04e57652ce421283f8e8169413d148fcf63540538d8e916077edf1e26b7.png] 

Total students = 15 + 25+ 15+ 15+ 25+ 20+ 30

⇒ Total students = 145
